Linux + macOS · Pure Rust

Your whole system fetched in milliseconds.

flexfetch is a blazing-fast, themeable system info tool. Zero subprocesses, pure Rust. Modules read /proc, sysfs, and macOS APIs directly.

$ curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mahesh-diwan/flexfetch/main/install.sh | sh
Quick start

01

Zero subprocesses

Every module reads kernel data directly — /proc, sysfs, or macOS APIs. No forking, no parsing overhead, no startup cost.

/proc/meminfodirect
/proc/cpuinfodirect
subprocesses0
02

Themes & gradients

Catppuccin, Dracula, Nord, Solarized, Tokyo Night — truecolor everywhere, per-module key/value colors, gradient accents.

catppuccin
dracula
tokyo night
03

ASCII & image logos

527 distro logos imported from fastfetch plus hand-tuned first-party art, and PNG/BMP images rendered as block characters with automatic palette extraction.

fastfetch imports527
custom logosfirst-party
image → block artpng/bmp
04

Live TUI dashboard

flexfetch --live opens a TUI with CPU, memory, and disk gauges, per-process bars, and network sparklines.

cpu
memory
network
05

Templates & exports

Tera templates with loops and conditionals for full layout control, plus exports to SVG, PNG, HTML, Markdown, CSV, and Prometheus.

tera templatessupported
svg / png / htmlexport

06

Custom modules & context

Define your own info sources in config, and smart fetch layers git, project type, container and SSH context from your working directory.

[custom] modulesconfig
smart contextgit/project
health score0-100

On your machine in one command.

Releases ship Linux (musl static, 3 arches) and macOS (arm64 + x86_64) binaries. Every artifact ships checksums and signatures for verification.

official

curl installer

Detects your platform, verifies the checksum before unpacking, and refuses to install anything if the file doesn't match.
